piece.headline: CHANDRU BACKS FODEN, HAALAND PAYS EVERYONE ELSE
piece.standfirst: Chandru passed on Haaland and took 2 from the armband. He still leads. Ravi Bhojwani topped the week.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Ravin left 22 points on the bench. Nobody else came close. Triple Captain on Haaland, and the team sheet still let him down.

winners.name: Prem
winners.verdict: 2 new faces, Groß and Cherki, and a jump up to 17th. The hit was worth it.

winners.name: Hishaan
winners.verdict: One Sangaré signing, and a leap to 11th. Biggest climb of the week.

losers.name: Poonam
losers.verdict: Fernandes as captain, and nobody else went there. Sangaré and Cherki cost a 13-point hit. Tough week.

losers.name: Vinesh
losers.verdict: Captained João Pedro for 2 with the armband while the field cashed in on Haaland.

losers.name: Aashiv
losers.verdict: Played the Wildcard, left 11 on the bench and slipped to 4th.
